name: dungeon-demo-server
description: MCP Apps server: 4-iframe dungeon-crawler hosted in Goose desktop. Three.js viewport + narration + stats + controls panes share server-side world state.

scripts.build:panes: npm run build:viewport && npm run build:narration && npm run build:stats && npm run build:controls
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && npm run build:panes
scripts.start: concurrently --raw "cross-env NODE_ENV=development INPUT=viewport.html vite build --watch" "cross-env NODE_ENV=development INPUT=narration.html vite build --watch" "cross-env NODE_ENV=development INPUT=stats.html vite build --watch" "cross-env NODE_ENV=development INPUT=controls.html vite build --watch" "tsx watch main.ts"
